names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Μαρτίου, «Αγίες Αλεξανδρία, Κλαυδία, Ευφρασία, Ματρώνα, Ιουλιανή, Ευφημία και Θεοδώρα που μαρτύρησαν στην Αμινσό», with the rank word and the clause of martyrdom left off. Her own heading on the life page is «Αγια Κλαυδια Που Μαρτυρησε Στην Αμινσο».

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2560, «Клавдия Амисийская (Понтийская), мц.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name and gives no by-name at all, «Мцц. Александры, Клавдии, Евфрасии, Матроны, Иулиании, Евфимии и Феодосии». Both brackets are the calendar's own — Pontus set beside Amisos — and are kept, as this wave keeps a bracketed surname; parentheses are not part of a fold key and `.tmp/fk.mjs` reports no folder holding this string.

death.note: Two readings and the interval holds both, choosing neither. days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 20 марта ст. ст. «(310)» and its life page closes «(+ 310)», and it sets the seizure under «императоре Максимиане Галерии (305 - 311)»; saint.gr, from which the folder's 303–305 came, gave «Το μαρτύριό τους έγινε μεταξύ των ετών 303 - 305 μ.Χ.» and the reign of «του ασεβούς αυτοκράτορα Μαξιμιανού (286 - 305 μ.Χ.)». The two pages name two different Maximians and two incompatible years — 310 lies outside 303–305 — so the bounds are widened to hold both and nothing is chosen.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 марта ст. ст. — «Мцц. Александры, Клавдии, Евфрасии, Матроны, Иулиании, Евфимии и Феодосии (310).»

attestations.note: The calendar prints all seven virgins on one line and closes it «(310)»; its life page sets the seizure «в городе Амисе (на берегу Черного моря)» in the persecution under «императоре Максимиане Галерии (305 - 311)». **That year is outside the bounds this folder held**, saint.gr's 303–305, so the interval is widened to hold both readings and chooses neither; the disagreement is set out under `dates`. The reading adds the manner of the death, which the folder did not hold: they confessed under questioning, were stripped and beaten with rods, their breasts cut off, then hung up and scraped over the body with sharpened hooks, and at the last burnt alive in a heated furnace. Life page life681 lists this day and no other, and the day page prints no hymn for them.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Μαρτίου — «Αγίες Αλεξανδρία, Κλαυδία, Ευφρασία, Ματρώνα, Ιουλιανή, Ευφημία και Θεοδώρα που μαρτύρησαν στην Αμινσό»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The day's line names all seven and the life page gives each of them a heading of her own, so the entry enumerates its members and is seven folders. The company is of Amisos in Pontus and is not the seven virgins of Ancyra the corpus keeps on 18 mai, who suffered in another city with other companions and out of another life.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
